snippet_primary: "If your product is NSFW, be sure to tag it by setting the toggle. Then, we will only display it to customers who opt in to see adult content. If your customers can't see your adult content on Discover, they will need to opt in by enabling the 'Show NSFW' toggle when searching: You can improve the placement of your products on Gumroad Discover by agreeing to an increased Discover fee. These promotional fees are only charged when a sale occurs after it was found on Discover, but does not apply to any sales made to the product outside of Discover."
